image.caption: One Extinction Rebellion demonstrator was keeping up standards outside the Treasury in London yesterday
Colin Pratt checks the cox’s apples in an orchard on the Leckford Estate, Hampshire, for harvesting next week

Early autumn winds left this bird decidedly dishevelled near Bourne, Lincolnshire. Sunny spells are expected in much of Britain today
Afghan children play at a brick kiln near Kabul where labourers, some as young as four, earn as little as $3 a day depending on how many bricks they make
The cake artist Michelle Wibowo used 45kg of sugar for her vanilla sponge version of Mr Darcy, as portrayed by Colin Firth in Pride and Prejudice
